verdict.rationale: The vendor's own `yy` CLI installs and updates these skills (`yy skills install` / `yy skills update`), and the skills document `yy ledger` subcommands for agent workflows. However, the CLI is presented as a separate YYLO product, and its documentation within this pack is limited to skill-level snippets. The `npx skills` installer is an open third-party CLI and earns no credit. Missing for 10: standalone first-party CLI reference documentation for YYLO Skills, a clear statement that the CLI ships as part of this product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
yy ledger create "Task description here" --status backlog --tags feature,backend
Register with `yy ledger project add ALIAS --path /absolute/project`, then route any command with `--project ALIAS`.
This repository is the canonical, independently versioned source for skills used by YYLO CLI, YYLO Ledger and YYLO Benchmark.
